text:
The series telescopes because  

\[
a_{n+1}+2=(a_n+2)(a_n^2+3a_n+4)
\]

so  

\[
\frac{2^{n}(a_n+1)}{a_n^{2}+3a_n+4}
= \frac{2^{n}}{a_n+2}-\frac{2^{n+1}}{a_{n+1}+2}.
\]

Summing from \(n=0\) to \(\infty\) gives a telescoping sum  

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{2^{n}(a_n+1)}{a_n^{2}+3a_n+4}
= \frac{1}{a_0+2}-\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2^{N+1}}{a_{N+1}+2}= \frac{1}{2024+2}
= \frac{1}{2026}.
\]

Hence the required value is  

**ANSWER: \(\displaystyle \frac{1}{2026}\)**
